en.html:
Why was I alive?

Why was I walking?
Where was this place?

No idea.

So many things, and about all of them, no idea. Apparently my brain had fallen out somewhere.

Should I go and pick it up?

No, leave it. It had never been much use anyway.

Let it lie.

Without unnecessary baggage, the load was lighter. That was better.

Certainly.

By the way, where was this place?

Familiar-looking. Or not.

There were people.
I could ask.

ja.html:
何故、生きているのだろう。

　何故、歩いているのだろう。
　ここは何処なのだろう。

　わからない。

　何だか、わからない事ばかりだ。

　いつの間にか脳味噌が抜け落ちたらしい。

　拾いに行こうか……。

　いや、いい。
　どうせ大して役に立たないものだ。

　放っておけ。

　余計なものなんて無い方が軽くていい。

　そうに決まってる。

　ところで、ここは何処だ？

　見覚えがあるような無いような。

　人がいる。
　訊いてみるか。

Kageaki"Excuse me. I am looking for my brain. Do you happen to know its whereabouts?"
Resident A"What are you lot roaming around for at this hour? Haan?! Suspicious fellows, just as we thought..."
Resident B"Breaking the bridge wasn't enough? What were you planning to do this time?!"
Refugee A"No! We were also going around checking for suspicious people!"
Refugee B"If the person who broke the bridge came out, we thought we could catch him..."
Resident A"Ha! Very likely! The culprits themselves are conducting the culprit search!"
Refugee A"I am TELLING you, it wasn't us! We didn't do it!"
Resident B"Shameless. If not you lot, who else would do it?!"

住民Ａ「お前ら、なんでこんな時間にうろうろして やがるんだ？　ああァ!? 　やっぱり怪しい奴らだ……」
住民Ｂ「橋を壊しただけじゃ足りないのか。 　今度は何をやるつもりだった!?」
難民Ａ「違う！ 　俺達も、怪しい奴がいないか見回ってたん だよ」
難民Ｂ「橋を壊した奴が出て来たら、捕まえようと 思って……」
住民Ａ「はっ。捕まるわけねえだろ。 　犯人が犯人を捜してるんじゃなァ！」
難民Ａ「だから、本当に違うんだ！ 　俺達はやってない！」
住民Ｂ「白々しい。 　お前らでなけりゃ誰がやるんだよ！」

en.html:
...Hmm.
They seemed to have some urgent business.

Nearly ten people were present, but all of them were so busy arguing that not one would listen to me.

This was not acceptable. According to my palm, this was a turning point in my life. I absolutely had to speak with them and decide whether to discard my brain or recover the five hundred yen I had paid to God.

Everything for the restoration of the Northern Court...

　何か立て込んでいるようだ。

　人は十人近くもいるが、言い合うのに忙しくて誰も

　全ては北朝復興のため……。

Kageaki"Directions, please. To God, my brain, nirvana or hell."
Kageaki"Ah, myself will also be acceptable. That activity. Finding oneself."
Refugee A"Huh?"
Refugee B"What are you... Arre, the liquor smell!"
Kageaki"Why would that be? Nobody here appears to be drunk."
Resident B"...Oi. Who brought this drunkard here?"
Resident A"How should I know? He came over by himself, no?"
Refugee B"Bhai, listen. Sorry, but we are in the middle of something."
Kageaki"Precisely. I too am in the middle of something. I do not know why I am alive."
Kageaki"Would any of you happen to know? Your guidance would be most gratefully received."
Resident B"Very high manners for a drunkard..."
Resident A"Arre, leave this fellow! YOU lot! We have not forgotten that bridge!"
Refugee A"I am telling you, we—"
Kageaki"What bridge is this?"
Refugee B"Well... look. Fallen into the river there. Somebody broke it. We can't cross."
Kageaki"I see. This is not good. But a bridge is only large chopsticks across a river, no? If those are broken, could we not cross with a fork? Or a spoon?"
Refugee B"..."
Refugee A"Don't answer him..."

景明「道をお尋ねします。 　神か、脳味噌か、涅槃か地獄へ」
景明「ああ、自分でも結構です。 　あれです。自分探し」
難民Ａ「は？」
難民Ｂ「何だよあんた…… 　うわっ、酒臭え！」
景明「何故でしょう。 　誰も酔ってはいないようですが」
住民Ｂ「……おい。誰だよ、こんな酔っ払い連れて 来たのは」
住民Ａ「知らねえって。 　勝手に寄って来たんだろ？」
難民Ｂ「なぁ、あんた。 　悪いけど今、取り込み中でさ」
景明「そうです。取り込んでいるのです。 　自分がなぜ生きているのかわかりません」
景明「何方かご存知ではないでしょうか？ 　願わくばご教示を賜りたく」
住民Ｂ「やけに丁寧な酔っ払いだな……」
住民Ａ「あー、こんなのはどうでもいい！ 　とにかくお前ら！　橋のことを忘れる気は ねえからな」
難民Ａ「だから、俺達は――」
景明「橋とは何ですか」
難民Ｂ「いや……ほら。そこの川に落ちてるだろ。 　壊されて、渡れないんだよ」
景明「成程。これはいけません。 　しかし自分が思うに――端を渡れないなら フォークかスプーンを渡れば良いのではない かと」
難民Ｂ「……」
難民Ａ「相手するなよ……」

Resident B"We needed that bridge for our daily lives."
Resident A"You think we'll leave it at that? Pay for the damage!"
Refugee A"Pay...? How can you—"
Resident A"If you can't—"
Kageaki"A fork."
Refugee A"A fork?"
Resident A"We'll drive every last one of you out!"
Kageaki"With a fork."
Refugee A"WITH A FORK?!"
Resident A"Whom are you talking to?! And YOU, get out of the way, drunkard!"
Kageaki"...?"
Resident A"You only! Stop looking around for another candidate!"
Kageaki"But I am not drunk."
Resident A"It is visible to the whole world that you are drunk!"
Kageaki"What. I was drunk all this time...?"
Kageaki"Then I should behave a little more like a drunkard. My apologies for the shortfall."
Resident A"ENOUGH PERFORMANCE ALREADY!!"
Resident B"Oi. Leave him alone."
Resident A"I know! ...Now listen. I'll say this once again."
Kageaki"Yes, please."
Resident A"NOT TO YOU, BLOODY BASTARD!"
Resident B"This is what I'm saying..."
Resident A"I KNOW! Listen, you refugees! Either pay up or get out!"
Refugee A"...You just say whatever suits you! We TOLD you we didn't do it!"
Resident A"Who cares! Either way, you lot are in our way!"
Refugee A"What did you say?!"

住民Ｂ「あの橋はな、俺達の生活に必要だったんだ」
住民Ａ「このままで済ませてたまるか。 　弁償しやがれ！」
難民Ａ「弁償って……そんな」
住民Ａ「できないってんなら――」
景明「フォークを」
難民Ａ「フォーク？」
住民Ａ「お前ら全員、追い出すまでだ！」
景明「フォークで」
難民Ａ「フォークで!?」
住民Ａ「誰と話してんだよ！ 　っていうか、邪魔だからあっち行ってろ、 酔っ払い!!」
景明「……？」
住民Ａ「お前だよ！　きょろきょろすんなっ！」
景明「自分は酔っていませんが」
住民Ａ「どう見ても酔ってるよ！」
景明「何と。 　自分は酔っていたのですか……」
景明「ではもう少し、酔っ払いらしく振舞った方 が良いですね」
住民Ａ「充分だっっ!!」
住民Ｂ「おい、構うなって」
住民Ａ「わかってる。 　……いいか。もう一度言っとく」
景明「はい」
住民Ａ「お前にじゃねえよっ！」
住民Ｂ「だからさ……」
住民Ａ「わかってるっ！ 　いいか難民ども！　弁償するか出て行くか どっちかだ！」
難民Ａ「……勝手ばっか言いやがって！ 　俺達はやってないって言ってるだろう！」
住民Ａ「知るか！ 　どのみち、お前らは邪魔なんだよ！」
難民Ａ「何だとぉ!?」

Kageaki"Please do not fight."
Resident A"Enough, man, just go somewhere else!"
Kageaki"No. You must not fight."
Kageaki"The fault is on my side."
Resident B"Huh?"
Kageaki"You should not be blaming each other. Blame me..."
Kageaki"I brought the calamities. I am at fault. Blame me. Punish me."
Refugee A"..."
Refugee B"..."
Kageaki"Please do that. Whatever you do to me is fine. You can kill me."
Kageaki"So..."
Kageaki"...So, please..."

The night sky spread above me.

The moon.
The broken moon.

...How had it become like that?

Ah, yes. Hikaru had kicked it apart.

What a mischievous fellow she was.

Funny.
The moon was broken. How could that not be funny?

I rolled on the ground laughing. My stomach hurt. Too much laughing; now even my stomach was objecting.

Ah... funny.
But.

Hikaru, tell me?

Why had you not smashed me like that also?

Why had you not taken me with you?

Why...
